name: slopless
description: Writes, edits, and audits marketing and SEO content so it reads like a knowledgeable person wrote it, and so every claim on the page is true.

interface.longDescription: Slopless writes, edits, and audits content against research-backed signatures of machine writing: buzzword lists from corpus studies, participial-tail and nominalization patterns, metronome sentence rhythm, templatic empathy and emotional flattening. It adds factual-integrity rules generic de-sloppers do not have: never fabricate statistics or testimonials, [VERIFY] markers for unconfirmed facts, YMYL care for legal, medical, and financial topics, and a local-specificity test for city pages. Three modes: write, edit (minimum change, voice preserved), and audit (named patterns with quotes, no rewrite).
